title: Pump unreachable with Medtronic 754 and Rileylink after AAPS 3.3.3.0 DEV-D update
body:
After updating to 3.3.3.0 DEV-D a few hours ago, my AAPS keeps giving me Pump unreacable alarms, but my pump is connected and workin g properly.
